notes: AHCI memory-mapped registers live in non-cacheable memory space behind PCI BAR5 (ABAR). Registers below offset 100h are Generic Host Control; the per-port register bank starts at 100h + (port × 80h) and spans 80h. Register accesses are limited to 64 bits maximum, must not cross an 8-byte alignment boundary, and locked accesses are not supported.
register_count: 11 Generic Host Control + 18 per-port (× up to 32 ports) + PCI Configuration Header + PCI PM + MSI + SATA Capability

generic_host_control_registers.name: CAP
generic_host_control_registers.description: Reports HBA capabilities: S64A, SNCQ, SSNTF, SMPS, SSS, SALP, SAL, SCLO, ISS[3:0] (max speed Gen 1/2/3), SAM, SPM, FBSS, PMD, SSC, PSC, NCS[4:0] (slots-per-port zero-based), CCCS, EMS, SXS, NP[4:0] (ports-per-HBA zero-based).

generic_host_control_registers.name: GHC
generic_host_control_registers.description: AE (AHCI Enable, bit 31), MRSM (MSI Revert to Single Message, bit 2 RO), IE (Interrupt Enable, bit 1), HR (HBA Reset, bit 0, RW1).

generic_host_control_registers.name: IS
generic_host_control_registers.description: IPS[31:0] — bit per port; set by HBA when the port has a pending interrupt, software write-1-to-clear.

generic_host_control_registers.name: PI
generic_host_control_registers.description: Bitmap of implemented + available ports; at least one bit must be set; maximum set bits ≤ CAP.NP+1.

generic_host_control_registers.name: VS
generic_host_control_registers.description: MJR (upper 16 b) + MNR (lower 16 b). 1.3.1 compliant HBA returns 0x00010301.

generic_host_control_registers.name: CCC_CTL
generic_host_control_registers.description: TV (Timeout Value, [31:16], 1 ms units), CC (Command Completions, [15:8]), INT (interrupt vector, [7:3] RO), EN (Enable, [0]).

generic_host_control_registers.name: CCC_PORTS
generic_host_control_registers.description: Per-port bitmap of ports that participate in CCC.

generic_host_control_registers.name: EM_LOC
generic_host_control_registers.description: OFST (offset of EM message buffer into ABAR, in Dwords, [31:16]) + SZ (buffer size in Dwords, [15:0]).

generic_host_control_registers.name: CAP2
generic_host_control_registers.description: DESO (DevSleep Entrance from Slumber Only, bit 5), SADM (Aggressive DevSleep Mgmt, bit 4), SDS (Supports Device Sleep, bit 3), APST (Automatic Partial→Slumber, bit 2), NVMP (NVMHCI Present, bit 1), BOH (BIOS/OS Handoff, bit 0).

generic_host_control_registers.name: BOHC
generic_host_control_registers.description: BB (BIOS Busy, bit 4), OOC (OS Ownership Change, bit 3, RWC), SOOE (SMI on OOC Enable, bit 2), OOS (OS Owned Semaphore, bit 1), BOS (BIOS Owned Semaphore, bit 0).

per_port_registers.name: PxCLB
per_port_registers.long_name: Port x Command List Base Address

per_port_registers.name: PxCLBU
per_port_registers.long_name: Port x Command List Base Address Upper

per_port_registers.name: PxFB
per_port_registers.description: 256 B aligned (bits 7:0 RO 0); 4 KB aligned when FBS in use (bits 11:0 RO 0).

per_port_registers.name: PxFBU
per_port_registers.long_name: Port x FIS Base Address Upper

per_port_registers.name: PxIS
per_port_registers.description: CPDS, TFES, HBFS, HBDS, IFS, INFS, OFS, IPMS, PRCS, DMPS, PCS, DPS, UFS, SDBS, DSS, PSS, DHRS bits.

per_port_registers.name: PxIE
per_port_registers.description: Per-bit enable mirror of PxIS for interrupt routing.

per_port_registers.name: PxCMD
per_port_registers.description: ICC[31:28] (Interface Communication Control: 1h Active / 2h Partial / 6h Slumber / 8h DevSleep), ASP (bit 27), ALPE (bit 26), DLAE (bit 25), ATAPI (bit 24), APSTE (bit 23), FBSCP (bit 22), ESP (bit 21), CPD (bit 20), MPSP (bit 19), HPCP (bit 18), PMA (bit 17), CPS (bit 16), CR (bit 15), FR (bit 14), MPSS (bit 13), CCS[12:8], FRE (bit 4), CLO (bit 3), POD (bit 2), SUD (bit 1), ST (bit 0).

per_port_registers.name: PxTFD
per_port_registers.description: STS[15:8] (BSY=bit7, DRQ=bit3, ERR=bit0), ERR[7:0] (latest Error byte from D2H Register FIS).

per_port_registers.name: PxSIG
per_port_registers.description: Signature returned by the device on the first D2H Register FIS — typically 0x00000101 (ATA disk) / 0xEB140101 (ATAPI) / 0xC33C0101 (Port Multiplier) / 0x96690101 (Enclosure Mgmt).

per_port_registers.name: PxSSTS
per_port_registers.description: DET[3:0] (00=no device, 01=Phy not est, 03=Phy + device, 04=offline), SPD[3:0] (1=Gen1, 2=Gen2, 3=Gen3), IPM[3:0] (1=Active, 2=Partial, 6=Slumber, 8=DevSleep).

per_port_registers.name: PxSCTL
per_port_registers.description: DET[3:0] (1=COMRESET issue, 4=disable), SPD[3:0] (cap), IPM[3:0] (3=disable Partial, C=disable Slumber, F=disable both).

per_port_registers.name: PxSERR
per_port_registers.description: ERR[15:0] (DataIntegrity, CommWake, etc.) + DIAG[31:16] (X=Exchanged bit 26, F=Unknown FIS bit 25, T=Transport state bit 24, S=Link Seq bit 23, H=Handshake bit 22, CRC bit 21, DB=10b Decode bit 20, COMWAKE bit 18, PhyInternal bit 17, N=PhyRdy Change bit 16).

per_port_registers.name: PxSACT
per_port_registers.description: Bit per slot; set by software for NCQ commands; cleared by HBA on Set Device Bits FIS with matching SActive bit.

per_port_registers.name: PxCI
per_port_registers.description: Bit per slot; software sets to issue a command; HBA clears on completion.

per_port_registers.name: PxSNTF
per_port_registers.description: PMN[15:0] — bit per Port Multiplier port indicating an Asynchronous Notification.

per_port_registers.name: PxFBS
per_port_registers.description: DWE[7:4] (Device With Error), ADO[15:12] (Active Dev Optimization), DEV[11:8] (target PM port), SDE (bit 2), DEC (bit 1, RW1), EN (bit 0).

per_port_registers.name: PxDEVSLP
per_port_registers.description: DM[28:25] (DITO Multiplier), DITO[24:15] (DevSleep Idle Timeout), MDAT[14:10] (Min DevSleep Assertion), DETO[9:2] (DevSleep Exit Timeout), DSP (bit 1), ADSE (bit 0). AHCI 1.3.1 only.

pci_configuration_header.name: CC
pci_configuration_header.description: Class Code = 0x010601 (Mass Storage / SATA / AHCI v1).

pci_configuration_header.name: ABAR
pci_configuration_header.description: AHCI Base Address (BAR5) — points to AHCI memory-mapped registers.

pci_capability_lists.name: PCI Power Management (PMCAP)
pci_capability_lists.description: PID + PC + PMCS — PME_Support, D0 / D3HOT only on AHCI (D1, D2 not supported).

pci_capability_lists.name: Message Signaled Interrupts (MSICAP)
pci_capability_lists.description: MID + MC + MA + MD + MUA — 32 / 64-bit MSI delivery.

pci_capability_lists.name: Serial ATA Capability (SATACAP)
pci_capability_lists.description: Optional. SATACR0 (MAJREV / MINREV / Cap ID 12h) + SATACR1 (BAROFST / BARLOC) — Index-Data Pair location.
